description: Use when the user is selling a large or valuable item (fitness equipment, hot tubs, saunas, golf carts, furniture, appliances), including when also posting to Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp. What comparable items sell or list for, as low / typical / high prices before delivery (buyers see these plus added_to_buyer_price_usd, in buyer_prices_usd): low is the 25th percentile, typical the median, high the top of where most sit (never below typical). take_home_usd is what a seller is paid when an item sells at each figure. sample_size counts every listing it is based on, sold and past ones included. model narrows it to listings whose titles name a brand, model or year; narrowed_to says whether it did, and model_matches how many listings name it (a range needs 5). basis says whether the range comes from sold items or listings; a narrowed range can differ in basis from the whole category. available: false means too little data for a range. The price the seller asked for on Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, or OfferUp becomes their take-home on Commonplace. The buyer price includes pickup and delivery.

category.description: A category name or slug, e.g. "hot tubs".

model.description: A brand, model or year to narrow to, e.g. "Kettler", "Bike+" or "2022". Matched against listing titles in the category.
